newsitem.title: CHINA: TRADING IN SHANGRI-LA ASIA SUSPENDED.
newsitem.headline: TRADING IN SHANGRI-LA ASIA SUSPENDED.

text.p: Trading in shares of Shangri-La Asia Ltd was suspended on Wednesday at the company's request pending an announcement, the Stock Exchange said.

The company is due to announce its interim results on Wednesday. A Shangri-La Asia spokeswoman declined to comment on the trading suspension but said the company was due to hold a news conference later on Wednesday on its interim results.
Shangri-La Asia plans to list its 50 percent owned China World Trade Center hotel operation and property investment company during the third quarter of this year.
The spokeswoman declined to say whether the trading suspension was linked to the initial public offering.
Shangri-La Asia shares closed at HK$8.80 on Tuesday.
